title: Actions to Correct Lapses in Administration of Enterprise Development Grant
what_it_is: Actions to Correct Lapses in Administration of Enterprise Development Grant

sections.label: EDG grant checks and clawback
sections.summary: ESG checks the 30% local shareholding criterion for EDG grants, withholds or claws back grants for breaches, and has begun a second round of checks before disbursement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: As of September 2020, ESG has supported almost 5,000 EDG projects.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Checks are performed during the grant approval process to ensure the EDG applicants meet the minimum 30% local shareholding criterion.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: If recipients are found to be in breach of the grant conditions, including the 30% local shareholding criterion, ESG will withhold or, if disbursement had been made, ESG will claw back the grant.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For the case raised in the AGO Report, no disbursement had been made to the company.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The company has also been placed on ESG’s watchlist for stricter scrutiny for future grant applications.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: ESG agrees with AGO’s recommendation and has commenced a second round of checks on shareholding eligibility before grant disbursement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: ESG is also studying the feasibility of improving such checks using tools, such as data analytics.
